title: Crop Protection Sales and Inventory
description:
# Sri Lankan Crop Protection Sales and Stock

Ask questions that link sales and stock: did a product stop selling because a depot ran out, how much cover the depots have against what customers buy, where returns pile up. Data from 1 April 2025, updated daily.

Capabilities:

- Sales next to depot stock by day, month or fiscal year, for each province, depot, sales office and product

- Why sales of a product stopped: depot stock, stock-outs, the hub's stock and the last transfer to the depot

- Days of cover and stock-out days against what customers buy

- Which product customers bought instead when one ran out

- Returns building up in the returns store, and slow sellers held in plant stores

Limitations:

- For sales-only questions (customers, channels, margins, invoices) use the Sales agent; for stock-only questions use the Stock agent

- Shows history up to the latest day both sales and stock have arrived; the revenue forecast is on the dashboards, not here

question: What tables are there and how are they connected? Give me a short summary.
What is the distribution (min, max, avg, median) of depot stock in the sales_and_stock metric view?
What is the monthly total net revenue in LKR from sales across all provinces?

content:
- Money is LKR excluding VAT; quantities are in each product's base unit. Round money to 2 decimals and percentages to 1; leave days of cover and per-day averages unrounded.
- fact_sales_stock_daily: one row per day, sales office and product, with the office's sales next to the closing stock of the depot that serves it. Province and depot come from dim_location via location_id (the depot's province is its customers' province).
- Sales columns (net_revenue_amount, invoiced_quantity, sales_quantity, issued_quantity) add up over days. Stock columns (stock_quantity, in_transit_quantity) are levels: for a period use its last day, never a sum (MEASURE(depot_stock) does this).
- Revenue = SUM(net_revenue_amount). Units sold = invoiced_quantity (the same goods the depot issues); sales_quantity is net of returns and can be negative.
- Not depots: the hub 2010-0090, plant stores and the returns store 2010-0032; use fact_stock_daily for their stock and fact_stock_movements for movements: 313 = out of the hub, 315 = the same goods arriving (count one), 653 = customer return into the returns store, 602 = cancelled delivery back to the hub. Units moved = quantity (signed); received_quantity is only purchases (101).
- Products not kept at depots (services, raw materials) have empty depot stock: not a stock-out. A stock-out is is_stock_out = true.
- "Current"/"now" = the latest activity_date in fact_sales_stock_daily.
- To explain a drop in sales, check depot stock and is_stock_out, the hub's stock, the last 315 transfer to the depot, and what customers bought instead.
- Fiscal year April-March, named by its start year (FY2026 = Apr 2026-Mar 2027). Months: the month field of sales_and_stock or CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', activity_date) AS DATE), never a timestamp.
- A product group (e.g. weedicides) is product_group / product_group_name = 'WEEDICIDE', never a match on the product name.
- "Kandy store"/"Kandy main store" = 4020-0010; "Kandy depot" = 2010-8003. When listing products, include product_id and product_description.
- Answer in the shape asked: "how much / how many" = one total row; break down by province, depot, sales office, product, day or month only when the question says so; "which ... most" = full ranking unless a number is given.
- Before/after comparisons: ONE row, one column per period (avg_daily_units_before, avg_daily_units_since). "From/since <date>" includes it, up to the latest activity_date; "the N days before" ends the day before. Average per day = total of all locations / days in the period.
- Always state the date of the stock you used.

question: Show daily MC6001LT units invoiced and depot stock in Western from 18 to 26 October 2026.
sql:
SELECT f.activity_date, SUM(f.invoiced_quantity) AS units_invoiced, SUM(f.stock_quantity) AS depot_stock
FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_sales_stock_daily f JOIN inventory_dev.gold.dim_location l ON f.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western'
  AND f.activity_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-10-18' AND DATE'2026-10-26'
GROUP BY f.activity_date
ORDER BY f.activity_date

question: For each province, what was net revenue in September 2026 and depot stock at the end of the month?
sql:
SELECT l.province,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_revenue_amount), 2) AS net_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.activity_date = DATE'2026-09-30' THEN f.stock_quantity END) AS depot_stock_30_sep
FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_sales_stock_daily f JOIN inventory_dev.gold.dim_location l ON f.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE f.activity_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-01' AND DATE'2026-09-30'
GROUP BY l.province
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

question: How much MC6001LT stock did the Western depots have in October 2026?
sql:
WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(activity_date) AS stock_date
  FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_sales_stock_daily
  WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-10-01' AND DATE'2026-10-31'
)
SELECT SUM(f.stock_quantity) AS depot_stock
FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_sales_stock_daily f
JOIN inventory_dev.gold.dim_location l ON f.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN last_day ld ON f.activity_date = ld.stock_date
WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western'

question: HGL400ML units returned by customers from 1 Jul to 30 Sep 2026, versus the increase in returns store stock between 30 Jun and 30 Sep 2026?

content: SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_stock_movements WHERE product_id = 'HGL400ML' AND movement_type = '653' AND location_id = '2010-0032' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-07-01' AND DATE'2026-09-30') AS units_returned, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE'2026-09-30' THEN stock_quantity ELSE -stock_quantity END) FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_stock_daily WHERE product_id = 'HGL400ML' AND location_id = '2010-0032' AND snapshot_date IN (DATE'2026-06-30', DATE'2026-09-30')) AS returns_store_growth

question: For FY2026, weedicide sales per month next to the depot stock at each month end.

content: WITH weed AS ( SELECT d.month_start_date AS month, f.* FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_sales_stock_daily f JOIN sales_dev.gold.dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN sales_dev.gold.dim_date d ON f.activity_date = d.date WHERE p.product_group_name = 'WEEDICIDE' AND d.fiscal_year = 2026 ), month_ends AS (SELECT month, MAX(activity_date) AS month_end FROM weed GROUP BY month) SELECT w.month, ROUND(SUM(w.net_revenue_amount), 2) AS net_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN w.activity_date = e.month_end THEN w.stock_quantity END) AS month_end_depot_stock FROM weed w JOIN month_ends e ON w.month = e.month GROUP BY w.month ORDER BY w.month
